name: range
title: Range
description: Two values on one track, with ink between them.
use: Two values on one scale: the lowest and the highest price, the start and the end of a clip. It is two native sliders in one group; each keeps its own keys, its own label and its own value in the form, and the smaller value is the lower bound.

instead.when: There is one value on the scale
The exact numbers matter more than the feel of the scale

keyboard.action: Moves from one thumb to the other; each is a tab stop
Move the focused thumb by one step, as the native range input does
Move the focused thumb to the lowest or the highest value

platform.fallback: The track stays a plain well under the two thumbs, and both inputs work as they always have

classes.name: range
classes.description: The group around the two sliders: one track, filled between its two thumbs. Give it role="group" and a name

classes.name: range-start
classes.description: On one of the two slider inputs: names its thumb for the fill

classes.name: range-end
classes.description: On the other slider input: names its thumb for the fill

states.name: disabled
states.description: On both slider inputs: the thumbs and the fill fade together
